scope: Reissue fresh verification for the committed removal of the placeholder fn_801D76A8 and fn_801D7998 ownership claims. Preserve fn_801D73D0 as NonMatching, preserve fn_801D7B78 as Matching, and keep the honest frontier at fn_801D76A8.

corrected_ownership.command: for scope in source config split; do case "$scope" in source) count=$(find src/game -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name 'game_fn_801D76A8.c' -o -name 'game_fn_801D7998.c' \) -print | wc -l);; config) count=$(rg -n 'game_fn_801D76A8.c|game_fn_801D7998.c' configure.py | wc -l);; split) count=$(rg -n 'game_fn_801D76A8.c|game_fn_801D7998.c' config/GEDE01/splits.txt | wc -l);; esac; printf 'stub_%s_entries=%s\n' "$scope" "$count"; done

frontier.consistency_command: jq -r '.next_target as $p | input.next_target as $f | "progress_next_target=\($p) frontier_next_target=\($f) equal=\($p==$f)"' reports/GEDE01/progress.json reports/GEDE01/frontier-801D73D0-801D7C24-session-1815.json
frontier.open_item_command: printf 'session_1815_open_item_count='; jq '[.open_items[] | select(startswith("Session session-1815 "))] | length' reports/GEDE01/progress.json

canonical_direct_objdiff.scope: Every registered object retained from session-1815 was freshly diffed after the rebuild. Removed placeholders have no source, split, or configured object to diff.
canonical_direct_objdiff.generation_command: for f in 801D73D0 801D7B78; do build/tools/objdiff-cli diff -p . -u main/game/game_fn_$f fn_$f -o build/GEDE01/remediation-1-reissue-1-$f-canonical.json --format json-pretty >/dev/null 2>&1; printf 'canonical_%s_exit=%s\n' "$f" "$?"; done
canonical_direct_objdiff.measurement_command: for f in 801D73D0 801D7B78; do jq -r --arg s fn_$f '(.left.symbols[]|select(.name==$s)) as $l | (.right.symbols[]|select(.name==$s)) as $r | ([ $l.instructions[] | select(.instruction.relocation != null) | {address:.instruction.address,formatted:.instruction.formatted,type:.instruction.relocation.type,type_name:.instruction.relocation.type_name,target_symbol:.instruction.relocation.target_symbol} ]) as $lr | ([ $r.instructions[] | select(.instruction.relocation != null) | {address:.instruction.address,formatted:.instruction.formatted,type:.instruction.relocation.type,type_name:.instruction.relocation.type_name,target_symbol:.instruction.relocation.target_symbol} ]) as $rr | "function=\($s) retail_bytes=\($l.size) generated_bytes=\($r.size) retail_instructions=\([$l.instructions[]|select(.instruction)]|length) generated_instructions=\([$r.instructions[]|select(.instruction)]|length) match_percent=\($l.match_percent) retail_relocations=\($lr|length) generated_relocations=\($rr|length) relocations_equal=\($lr==$rr)"' build/GEDE01/remediation-1-reissue-1-$f-canonical.json; done
